patches.title: Open Before Moving
patches.principle: When you arrive at a closed container, open it immediately before moving to any other container.
patches.when_to_apply: When exploring containers to find a target object.

patches.title: Cabinets First for Clean
patches.principle: For cleaning tasks, always search cabinets first as they are the most common location for items like soapbars, plates, and bowls.
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of a clean task when the target object's location is unknown.
